description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for virtual input devices, including key, mouse, and touch input types, within the WPEFramework project. It declares enums, structs, and message types for inter-process communication related to virtual input events.

classes.name: LinkInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a virtual input link, including mode and name.

classes.name: KeyData
classes.description: Represents key input data, including action type and key code.

classes.name: MouseData
classes.description: Represents mouse input data, including action, button, and movement.

classes.name: TouchData
classes.description: Represents touch input data, including action, index, and coordinates.

methods.name: enum inputtypes
methods.description: Enumeration of input device types: key, mouse, touch.

methods.name: Core::IPCMessageType
methods.description: Template class for defining IPC message types with specific message IDs and payload types.
